author: MadaraKaton
quote:
13 years for a game riddled with bugs and glitches, you do endless chores ( NOT optional all of them ) Rockstar is dead, and I am glad I got my refund. Truly an absolute joke **** from Rockstar, but alas.

Only the graphics are good, the driving feels terrible at 30 fps. You are way too restricted, protected classes, no prostitution, you are forced to partake in a relationship with someone, you don't have the choice to break up with Jason or Lucia, you cannot roleplay as you could in previous games, your destination is set. You are just on rails, doing the most mundane things you already do IRL.

Rockstar, it was nice knowing you, but you don't have the magic anymore. Sad.
